en.title: Alibi of the Pristine Ice Castle
en.premise: In the Western-style mansion 'Hyosokan,' isolated from the world by a raging blizzard, a wealthy man is found dead inside a locked room. At the scene, not even a trace remains of the 'Nameless Cat,' the master's beloved pet. Amidst a perfect physical locked room, the victim maintains a silence as cold as ice. Armed with two contradictory logical fragments—scattered glass shards and an unnatural shift in temperature—Detective Kujo sets out to unravel an inexplicable disappearance.

zh.title: 无垢之冰城的不在证明
zh.premise: 在被暴风雪与世隔绝的洋馆“冰霜馆”中，一名富豪被发现死于密室之中。现场甚至连原本应是主人爱猫的“无名之猫”也消失得无影无踪。受害者在完美的物理密室中，守护着如冰般寒冷的沉默。侦探九条凭借着散落的玻璃碎片与不自然的温度变化这两块矛盾的逻辑碎片，开始解开这场不可思议的消失之谜。
